en: The postcard features a sepia-toned image of a grand residential villa or mansion with a decorative fence and a tree-lined garden. The house has an ornate architectural style typical of late 19th to early 20th-century central European design, featuring dormer windows and a substantial roof. The street in the foreground appears empty. There is printed text identifying Oberlößnitz and a publication note from Otto Ziller.
